segments.say: This checkmate happened in a real game in 1910. And it started with a queen sacrifice.
segments.caption: Real game, 1910

segments.say: Vienna, 1910. Réti against Tartakower. Black just grabbed a knight in the center.
segments.caption: Black looks fine

segments.say: Réti plays queen d8, check! Giving away the queen.
segments.caption: Queen d8!!

segments.say: Bishop g5. Double check! The bishop and the rook both attack the king.
segments.caption: Double check!

segments.say: King c7. And bishop d8. Checkmate.
segments.caption: Bishop d8 mate

segments.say: One of the most beautiful finishes in chess history. Would you have seen the queen sac?
segments.caption: Would YOU see it?
